title: Production dependencies include unused vercel CLI (^50.39.0), deprecated sib-api-v3-sdk (^8.5.0), and firebase-functions (^7.2.2)
impact: None of these 3 packages is imported in src/, yet vercel and sib-api-v3-sdk pull in the majority of the 97 npm audit vulnerabilities (including Critical tar/handlebars/path-to-regexp advisories and deprecated superagent@3/formidable@1/glob@7).
recommendation: Run 'npm uninstall vercel sib-api-v3-sdk firebase-functions' at the repository root and invoke the Vercel CLI via npx or CI runners.

title: Unpatched Critical and High vulnerabilities in direct runtime dependencies (next, @tiptap/*, zod, @google/genai)
impact: npm audit reports a Critical advisory in next@^16.2.1 (<=16.4.0), High advisories in @tiptap/core (<=3.30.4), prosemirror-view (<1.42.3), and zod (<4.6.6), and a High advisory in functions' @google/genai@^0.13.0 (0.9.0-1.8.0).
recommendation: Upgrade next and eslint-config-next to ^16.4.6, @tiptap/* to ^3.33.1, zod to ^4.6.7, and functions' @google/genai to ^3.2.0, then run npm audit fix.

title: Duplicate animation (framer-motion + motion), UI primitive (radix-ui + @radix-ui/*), and TipTap extension packages
impact: 54 files import framer-motion while 8 import motion/react, bundling two versions of Motion (12.23.25 and 12.38.0); 3 files import monolithic radix-ui alongside 14 @radix-ui/react-* packages; 11 @tiptap/extension-* packages duplicate @tiptap/starter-kit.
recommendation: Consolidate all animation imports onto a single package (framer-motion or motion), standardize Radix imports, and uninstall the 11 redundant @tiptap/extension-* packages.

title: 32 declared dependencies in root package.json are unused or only imported by dead files
impact: One-third of root dependencies (including mathjs, mathlive, zod, @polar-sh/nextjs, @hookform/resolvers, @lucide/lab, @vercel/analytics, @vercel/speed-insights, cobe, react-globe.gl, three, @google-cloud/vertexai) are never used in active code.
recommendation: Uninstall unused dependencies or wire up intended packages (@vercel/analytics, @vercel/speed-insights, zod validation schemas).

title: Version mismatches across jest@30 vs ts-jest@29, next vs eslint-config-next, and root vs functions manifests
impact: ts-jest@^29.4.6 does not officially support jest@^30.2.0; eslint-config-next (16.0.7) lags next (^16.2.1); root and functions/ specify different ranges for react, react-dom, firebase-admin, and typescript.
recommendation: Align eslint-config-next with next, synchronize shared dependency ranges across root and functions/package.json, and migrate Jest transform to next/jest or a Jest-30-compatible transformer.

title: Missing engines field and .nvmrc at root, outdated @types/node (^20), and unconfigured outputFileTracingRoot
impact: Running npm ci under Node 24 triggers EBADENGINE in functions/ (which requires Node 22) while root has no engine constraint, and next build warns about parent lockfile /Users/pradeepmahdevu/package-lock.json.
recommendation: Add engines: { node: '>=22 <23' } to root package.json, add .nvmrc with '22', upgrade @types/node to ^22, and set outputFileTracingRoot in next.config.mjs.
